pages.text: Each batch takes $(item)1 second$() and uses:$(br2)$(li)1 $(item)Crushed Iron Ore$() (crush raw iron in Crushing Wheels),$(li)1 $(item)flux$(): $(item)Limesand$(), made by crushing limestone,$(li)1 $(item)Coal Coke Dust$(), which works as a catalyst (next page).$(br2)It gives:

$(li)$(item)144 mB Molten Steel$(), exactly one steel ingot in a casting basin,$(li)$(item)288 mB Molten Slag$().$(br2)$(l)Running it$()$(br)Feed the three items through funnels on the vat. The vat has 4 input slots and each holds one kind of item, so crushed iron, limesand and coke dust each take their own slot.

Pump both fluids out of the output side. A recipe only starts when all its products fit, so a vat full of slag stops making steel. Send the molten steel to casting basins, as in the steel chapter, and do something with the slag.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
